prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1438; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the body shop following a side impact at an intersection. The damage to the driver-side front door, rear quarter panel and adjacent sill is largely consistent with the reported collision geometry, and the pattern of crush and paint transfer matches the account given. Repair plan calls for door replacement, quarter panel repair and refinishing, with labor hours that fit the scope of the visible damage. The invoice history reviewed shows no repeated charges for the same work. Nothing in the file points to earlier damage on this vehicle in the affected areas. Recommend approval of the repair as presented.
